content_data.meeting_title: Q-Series Aircraft Certification Strategy and Regulatory Compliance Review
agenda_items: Export control compliance framework updates for defense-adjacent components
Safety management system integration across newly acquired subsidiaries
Budget reallocation for extended certification testing requirements
EASA and FAA certification timeline alignment for Q-Series platform
Supplier audit findings and corrective action status across European and Asian facilities
key_decisions: Mandated immediate implementation of enhanced traceability protocols across all Tier 1 suppliers
Greenlit partnership with external aviation law firm specializing in international certification harmonization
Approved delay of commercial launch by 4 months to ensure full regulatory compliance across all target markets
action_items: Regional Directors to assess local regulatory landscape changes and report findings within 6 weeks
Chief Compliance Officer to present revised global compliance framework to Board within 3 weeks
General Counsel to finalize export control classification for new avionics suite within 10 days
CFO to prepare detailed financial impact analysis of certification delay for executive committee review in 2 weeks
Head of Engineering to coordinate with certification authorities on updated test protocol submission within 5 weeks
